---
title: "Glosario"
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

Términos que aparecen en los tutoriales, explicados una sola vez y comparados en los tres lenguajes. Busca un término, filtra por sección o resalta tu lenguaje; cada tarjeta se puede contraer con un clic en su título.

```{=html}
<style>
#glosario-app { --c-py: #2C5F8A; --c-r: #1B7A5C; --c-jl: #7B4EA3; }
.gl-controls { position: sticky; top: 58px; z-index: 10; display: grid; gap: .6rem; padding: .8rem 0; background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(127,127,127,.3); }
@media (max-width: 767px), (max-height: 820px) { .gl-controls { position: static; } }
.gl-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .45rem; }
.gl-lbl { font-size: .85rem; opacity: .8; margin-right: .2rem; }
.gl-chip { border: 1px solid currentColor; background: transparent; color: inherit; border-radius: 999px; padding: .2rem .85rem; font-size: .85rem; cursor: pointer; opacity: .85; }
.gl-chip:hover { opacity: 1; }
.gl-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #9B1B2A; border-color: #9B1B2A; color: #fff; opacity: 1; }
.gl-chip.py[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--c-py); border-color: var(--c-py); }
.gl-chip.r[aria-pressed="true"]  { background: var(--c-r);  border-color: var(--c-r); }
.gl-chip.jl[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--c-jl); border-color: var(--c-jl); }
.gl-chip:focus-visible, .gl-head:focus-visible, .gl-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #378ADD; outline-offset: 3px; }
.gl-btn { border: 0; background: transparent; color: #378ADD; font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; padding: .2rem .4rem; }
.gl-count { margin-left: auto; font-size: .85rem; opacity: .8; }
.gl-sec h2 { margin-top: 2.2rem; }
.gl-card { border: 1px solid rgba(127,127,127,.3); border-radius: 12px; padding: 1rem 1.1rem 1.1rem; margin: 1rem 0; background: rgba(127,127,127,.05); scroll-margin-top: 150px; }
.gl-card.gl-hl { outline: 3px solid #E0A400; }
.gl-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; }
.gl-head { all: unset; box-sizing: border-box; flex: 1; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; }
.gl-chev { font-size: .9rem; opacity: .6; transition: transform .15s; }
.gl-head[aria-expanded="false"] .gl-chev { transform: rotate(-90deg); }
.gl-anchor { text-decoration: none !important; color: inherit !important; opacity: .45; font-weight: 700; }
.gl-anchor:hover { opacity: 1; }
.gl-def { margin: .5rem 0 .2rem; }
.gl-cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: .8rem; margin: .8rem 0; }
@media (max-width: 900px) { .gl-cols { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
.gl-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; border: 1px solid rgba(127,127,127,.3); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; transition: opacity .15s; }
.gl-colh { color: #fff; font-weight: 600; font-size: .85rem; letter-spacing: .03em; padding: .3rem .7rem; }
.gl-py .gl-colh { background: var(--c-py); }
.gl-r .gl-colh  { background: var(--c-r); }
.gl-jl .gl-colh { background: var(--c-jl); }
.gl-pre { margin: 0; padding: .6rem .7rem; background: rgba(127,127,127,.12); border: 0; border-radius: 0; font-size: .8rem; line-height: 1.45; overflow-x: auto; white-space: pre; }
.gl-pre code { background: none; color: inherit; padding: 0; font-size: inherit; }
.gl-note { margin: 0; padding: .5rem .7rem .65rem; font-size: .86rem; flex: 1; }
.gl-key { margin: .2rem 0 0; padding: .6rem .85rem; border-left: 4px solid #D97706; background: rgba(217,119,6,.1); border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0; font-size: .92rem; }
.foco-py .gl-col:not(.gl-py), .foco-r .gl-col:not(.gl-r), .foco-jl .gl-col:not(.gl-jl) { opacity: .4; }
.gl-vacio { padding: 1.5rem 0; opacity: .8; }
</style>

  var LENGS = [
    { k: 'py', nombre: 'Python' },
    { k: 'r',  nombre: 'R' },
    { k: 'jl', nombre: 'Julia' }
  ];
  var app = document.getElementById('glosario-app');
  if (!app) return;

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
  }
  function norm(s) {
    return String(s).normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').toLowerCase();
  }

  var estado = { q: '', sec: 'todas', foco: 'todos' };

  var chipsSec = '<button type="button" class="gl-chip" data-sec="todas" aria-pressed="true">Todas</button>' +
    SECCIONES.map(function (s) {
      return '<button type="button" class="gl-chip" data-sec="' + s[0] + '" aria-pressed="false">' + esc(s[1]) + '</button>';
    }).join('');
  var chipsFoco = '<button type="button" class="gl-chip" data-foco="todos" aria-pressed="true">Los 3</button>' +
    LENGS.map(function (l) {
      return '<button type="button" class="gl-chip ' + l.k + '" data-foco="' + l.k + '" aria-pressed="false">' + l.nombre + '</button>';
    }).join('');

  app.innerHTML =
    '<div class="gl-controls">' +
      '<label class="visually-hidden" for="gl-q">Buscar un término</label>' +
      '<input id="gl-q" type="search" class="form-control" placeholder="Buscar un término: índice, vector, for, copia…" autocomplete="off">' +
      '<div class="gl-row" role="group" aria-label="Filtrar por sección">' + chipsSec + '</div>' +
      '<div class="gl-row" role="group" aria-label="Resaltar un lenguaje"><span class="gl-lbl">Resaltar:</span>' + chipsFoco + '</div>' +
      '<div class="gl-row"><button type="button" class="gl-btn" id="gl-exp">Expandir todo</button>' +
      '<button type="button" class="gl-btn" id="gl-con">Contraer todo</button>' +
      '<span class="gl-count" id="gl-count" aria-live="polite"></span></div>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<div id="gl-lista"></div>' +
    '<p class="gl-vacio" id="gl-vacio" hidden>Ningún término coincide con tu búsqueda. Prueba con otra palabra o quita el filtro de sección.</p>';

  function colHtml(l, d) {
    var code = d.code ? '<pre class="gl-pre"><code>' + esc(d.code) + '</code></pre>' : '';
    return '<div class="gl-col gl-' + l.k + '"><div class="gl-colh">' + l.nombre + '</div>' + code +
      '<p class="gl-note">' + esc(d.note) + '</p></div>';
  }

  function cardHtml(t) {
    var texto = [t.term, t.defn, t.key, t.alias || ''];
    LENGS.forEach(function (l) { texto.push(t[l.k].note); if (t[l.k].code) texto.push(t[l.k].code); });
    return '<article class="gl-card" id="t-' + t.id + '" data-sec="' + t.sec + '" data-text="' + esc(norm(texto.join(' '))) + '">' +
      '<div class="gl-top">' +
        '<button type="button" class="gl-head" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="p-' + t.id + '">' +
          '<span>' + esc(t.term) + '</span><span class="gl-chev" aria-hidden="true">▾</span></button>' +
        '<a class="gl-anchor" href="#t-' + t.id + '" aria-label="Enlace directo a ' + esc(t.term) + '">#</a>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<p class="gl-def">' + esc(t.defn) + '</p>' +
      '<div class="gl-panel" id="p-' + t.id + '">' +
        '<div class="gl-cols">' + LENGS.map(function (l) { return colHtml(l, t[l.k]); }).join('') + '</div>' +
        '<p class="gl-key"><strong>Diferencia clave.</strong> ' + esc(t.key) + '</p>' +
      '</div>' +
    '</article>';
  }

  document.getElementById('gl-lista').innerHTML = SECCIONES.map(function (s) {
    var cards = TERMINOS.filter(function (t) { return t.sec === s[0]; }).map(cardHtml).join('');
    return '<section class="gl-sec" data-sec="' + s[0] + '"><h2>' + esc(s[1]) + '</h2>' + cards + '</section>';
  }).join('');

  var cards = Array.prototype.slice.call(app.querySelectorAll('.gl-card'));
  var secciones = Array.prototype.slice.call(app.querySelectorAll('.gl-sec'));

  function filtrar() {
    var q = norm(estado.q.trim());
    var visibles = 0;
    cards.forEach(function (c) {
      var ok = (estado.sec === 'todas' || c.getAttribute('data-sec') === estado.sec) &&
               (!q || c.getAttribute('data-text').indexOf(q) !== -1);
      c.hidden = !ok;
      if (ok) visibles++;
    });
    secciones.forEach(function (s) {
      s.hidden = !s.querySelector('.gl-card:not([hidden])');
    });
    document.getElementById('gl-vacio').hidden = visibles !== 0;
    document.getElementById('gl-count').textContent = 'Mostrando ' + visibles + ' de ' + cards.length + ' términos';
  }

  function pulsar(grupo, attr, valor) {
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(app.querySelectorAll('[' + attr + ']'), function (b) {
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', b.getAttribute(attr) === valor ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
  }

  function setPanel(card, abrir) {
    var btn = card.querySelector('.gl-head');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', abrir ? 'true' : 'false');
    card.querySelector('.gl-panel').hidden = !abrir;
  }

  app.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var el = e.target.closest('button');
    if (!el || !app.contains(el)) return;
    if (el.hasAttribute('data-sec')) {
      estado.sec = el.getAttribute('data-sec'); pulsar('sec', 'data-sec', estado.sec); filtrar();
    } else if (el.hasAttribute('data-foco')) {
      estado.foco = el.getAttribute('data-foco'); pulsar('foco', 'data-foco', estado.foco);
      app.className = estado.foco === 'todos' ? '' : 'foco-' + estado.foco;
    } else if (el.classList.contains('gl-head')) {
      var card = el.closest('.gl-card');
      setPanel(card, el.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true');
    } else if (el.id === 'gl-exp' || el.id === 'gl-con') {
      cards.forEach(function (c) { setPanel(c, el.id === 'gl-exp'); });
    }
  });

  document.getElementById('gl-q').addEventListener('input', function (e) {
    estado.q = e.target.value; filtrar();
  });

  function irAlHash() {
    var h = location.hash;
    if (h.indexOf('#t-') !== 0) return;
    var c = document.getElementById(h.slice(1));
    if (!c) return;
    estado.q = ''; estado.sec = 'todas';
    document.getElementById('gl-q').value = '';
    pulsar('sec', 'data-sec', 'todas');
    filtrar();
    setPanel(c, true);
    c.classList.add('gl-hl');
    c.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' });
    setTimeout(function () { c.classList.remove('gl-hl'); }, 2500);
  }
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', irAlHash);

  filtrar();
  irAlHash();
})();
</script>
```
